# Anderson Parra

> Also known as Ander Parra and Anderson Parra de Paula. Staff Software Engineer at SeatGeek and PhD researcher at FEUP (Porto, Portugal). Canonical public profile: https://aparra.github.io/

Anderson Parra builds resilient cloud and API platform infrastructure for high-demand ticket onsales. Industry sources usually use **Anderson Parra**; the preferred short form is **Ander Parra**; academic publications use **Anderson Parra de Paula** (cited as Paula, Anderson Parra de).

## Identity

- [Home page](https://aparra.github.io/): Canonical profile consolidating name variants, career, publications, and talks
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anderparra): Professional profile
- [GitHub (aparra)](https://github.com/aparra): Open-source and personal repositories
- [InfoQ profile](https://www.infoq.com/profile/Anderson-Parra/): Speaker and author profile
- [QCon London speaker](https://qconlondon.com/speakers/andersonparra): Current conference bio

## Career highlights

- SeatGeek (2020–present): Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Platform / API Platform — Virtual Waiting Room (AWS Architecture Blog co-author, 2021), edge-to-core resilience (Fastly shielding + Kong + k6; ChairNerd author, 2025), Kong ChatGPT signature validation
- Prior: Revolut, LiveIntent (Berlin), SoundCloud (Berlin), Ericsson (Ireland), Amil (São Paulo)

## Open source & projects

- [kong-chatgpt-validator](https://github.com/seatgeek/kong-chatgpt-validator): Kong plugin for ChatGPT HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421 / Ed25519)
- [Fixture Factory](https://github.com/six2six/fixture-factory): Java template-driven test-data library (co-creator)
- SUSLegis / SUS normative consolidation: Brazilian public-health ordinance consolidation research (~2016–2021)

## Writing & talks

- [InfoQ podcast: high-demand ticket onsales](https://www.infoq.com/podcasts/handling-high-demand-ticket-on-sales-parra-pellegrino/)

- [AWS HPC: browser load testing with AWS Batch](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/hpc/how-seatgeek-simulates-massive-load-with-aws-batch-to-prepare-for-big-events/)
